rows.text: Made from 100% natural ingredients with no added preservatives.

rows.text: Fits most 6.5 inch smartphones. Easy to clean.

rows.text: 12 month warranty. Keep your receipt as proof of purchase.
rows.shona: Garandi yemwedzi 12. Chengeta risiti yako sechiratidzo chekutenga.

rows.text: Machine washable at 30°C. Do not bleach. Tumble dry low.
rows.shona: Mashini inogona kushambidzwa pa30°C. Usaita kuti zvinhu zvicheneswe. Dzvinyirira pasi.

rows.text: Suitable for children aged 3 years and above.
rows.shona: Inokodzera vana vane makore 3 zvichikwira.

rows.text: Battery lasts up to 20 hours on a single charge.
rows.shona: Bhatiri rinopedza maawa 20 richibhadharwa kamwe chete.

rows.text: This iodized table salt is ideal for everyday cooking. It is finely ground and fortified with iodine. Store in a cool, dry place.
rows.shona: Munyu uyu wetafura une iodine unokodzera kubika zuva nezuva. Yakanyatsodyarwa uye yakasimbiswa neyodi. Chengetedza panzvimbo inotonhorera uye yakaoma.

rows.text: This smartphone has a 6.5 inch display and a 50MP camera. The 5000mAh battery lasts all day. It supports dual SIM cards and 5G networks.
rows.shona: Iyi smartphone ine kuratidzwa kwemasendimita 6.5 uye kamera ye50MP. Bhatiri re5000mAh rinogara zuva rose. Inotsigira dual SIM makadhi uye 5G network.

rows.text: Our roller meal is milled from the finest white maize. It cooks into smooth, fluffy sadza every time. Store in a cool, dry place and use within 6 months of opening.
rows.shona: Zvokudya zvedu zvinopetwa zvinogadzirwa nechibage chena chakanakisisa. Inobika ikava sadza yakatsetseka, ine ruzha nguva dzose. Chengetedza munzvimbo inotonhorera, yakaoma uye shandisa mukati memwedzi mitanhatu mushure mekuvhura.

rows.text: Stay warm this winter with our thick wool blanket. The soft fabric is gentle on the skin. Available in double bed size only.
rows.shona: Ramba uchidziya munguva yechando nechifukidziro chedu chakakora chemvere. Mucheka wakapfava uri munyoro paganda. Inowanikwa chete muhukuru hwemubhedha wechipiri.

rows.text: Apply 400 kg per hectare at planting. Place the fertiliser in the planting hole and cover with soil. Keep away from children and animals. Wash hands after use.
rows.shona: Shandisa 400 kg pahekita pakudyara. Isa fetiraiza mugomba rokudyara uye rifukidze nevhu. Gara kure nevana nemhuka. Geza maoko pashure pokushandisa.

rows.text: Charge in direct sunlight for 8 hours. The lamp gives up to 12 hours of bright light. It can also charge your phone through the USB port.
rows.shona: Bhadharisa muzuva rakananga kwemaawa masere. Rambi racho rinopa chiedza chinopenya kwemaawa 12. Inogonawo kubhadharisa foni yako kuburikidza nechiteshi cheUSB.

rows.text: WARNING: Contains peanuts and tree nuts. Keep out of reach of children.
rows.shona: Yambiro: Inosanganisira nzungu nemiti yemiti. Ramba uri kure nevana.

rows.text: Allergen information: Contains wheat, milk, eggs and soy. May contain traces of nuts.
rows.shona: Allergen ruzivo: Rine gorosi, mukaka, mazai uye soya. Inogona kunge iine zviratidzo zvemakwenzi.

rows.text: Do not exceed the stated dose. If symptoms persist, consult your doctor.
rows.shona: Usapfuure muyero wakataurwa. Kana zviratidzo zvichiramba zviripo, bvunza chiremba wako.

rows.text: Keep away from fire. Do not use near open flames.
rows.shona: Ramba kure nemoto. Usashandise pedyo nemoto wakavhurika.

rows.text: Not suitable for children under 3 years. Small parts may be a choking hazard.
rows.shona: Hazvina kukodzera vana vari pasi pemakore matatu. Zvikamu zviduku zvinogona kuita kuti munhu anyure.

rows.text: Store below 25°C. Once opened, keep refrigerated and consume within 3 days.
rows.shona: Chengetedza pasi pe25°C. Kana zvangovhurwa, chengeta mufiriji uye udye mukati memazuva matatu.

rows.text: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes.
rows.shona: Zvokushandisa zvokunze chete. Dzivisa kusangana nemaziso.

rows.text: Always follow the preparation instructions on the pack. Use boiled water cooled to 70°C.
rows.shona: Nguva dzose tevera mirayiridzo yekugadzirira iri pakapu. Shandisa mvura yakabikwa yakatonhora kusvika 70°C.

rows.text: Returns accepted within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in original packaging.
rows.shona: Kudzoka kunogamuchirwa mukati memazuva makumi matatu ekuendeswa. Zvinhu zvinofanira kunge zvisina kushandiswa uye zviri mumapakeji ekutanga.
